page.layout: One column of roman text, running from the top of the page to about two-thirds down. Below it a title in black letter, with a parenthesised subtitle in black letter. Below that, one paragraph of black letter, continuing onto the next page. No marginal notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: per omnes civitates, terras,castra, pas-sus,pon-tes & loca quæcunque, absq; omni grauamine & solutione datii, pedagii, telonii, passagii aut ullius alterius oneris exactione, eundo, stando & redeundo, liberè & securè pertrans-ire permittatis, & id vestris officialibus de-mandare velitis, nobis ad beneplacitum sum-mè gratum, apud vos omnes & singulos ac vo-bis subjectos grata, ut decet, vicisitudine re-compensandum. Datum in civitate nostra Mo-nacensi, Anno Domini millesimo quadringen-tesimo octuagesimo primo, vigesima octava die mensis Decembris.

head.bl:
Sendschreiben Herzen Pirckey-mers/ an Keyser Maximilian den ersten/ &c.
(auß seinem eigenen Concept mundirt.)

p.bl: Allerdurchleuchtigster[?] Großmächtiger Keyser, allergnedigster Herr, euer Keyserlichen Majestat schreiben, betreffend den Druck, so etwan hie auff anhalten Joseph Grumpecken außgangen ist, hab ich mit unterthenigter Reverentz und schuldigem Gehorsam empfangen, und darauff mit dem Trucker solchs Buchs, laut E. Majestat Befelch, gehandelt, der mir angezeigt, daß er solcher Exemplar gar keins mehr hab, sondern Grum-

page.notes: The initial of "Allerdurchleuchtigster" is a large decorated letter that I read as A; marked uncertain. Faint marks at the lower left below the last line and small marks in the margins are stains or printing residue, not text. The black-letter passages are rendered in bl tags, and the u/v spelling is normalised in the German as well.
